name: bld_exists_bipartite_subgraph_half_edges
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : ∃ H : SimpleGraph V, H ≤ G ∧ H.Colorable 2 ∧ G.edgeSet.ncard ≤ 2 * H.edgeSet.ncard
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj], ∃ H : SimpleGraph V, H ≤ G ∧ H.Colorable 2 ∧ G.edgeSet.ncard ≤ 2 * H.edgeSet.ncard
informal: Uses Mathlib2.comb_exists_cut_half_edges: take the cut s from the library theorem and let H be the subgraph of G consisting of edges between s and sᶜ; it is 2-coloured by membership in s, and its edges biject with the ordered pairs counted in the cut.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj], ∃ H ≤ G, H.Colorable 2 ∧ G.edgeSet.ncard ≤ 2 * H.edgeSet.ncard
